message:
# Fix binary path in package.json

## Problem
The `npx site2pdf-cli` command was failing with `sh: site2pdf: command not found` error because the binary path in `package.json` was incorrect.

## Root Cause
- `package.json` had `"site2pdf": "bin/index.js"` in the bin configuration
- The actual binary file is located at `bin/site2pdf.js`
- This mismatch caused npm/npx to look for a non-existent file

## Solution
- Updated `package.json` to correctly reference `"site2pdf": "bin/site2pdf.js"`
- Verified the binary file exists and is executable
- Tested locally to ensure the fix works

## Testing
- ✅ Built the project successfully with `npm run build`
- ✅ All tests pass (4/4 tests passing)
- ✅ Binary executes correctly when called directly
- ✅ No regressions introduced

## Impact
After this fix is published, users will be able to successfully run:
```bash
npx site2pdf-cli https://example.com
```
